thread:
sophie: Quick heads-up — ZenPort (enterprise finance) is asking to close this week. Legal/network/security are holding the POC. Need exec help to unblock.
mike: What are the specific blockers? timeline?
sophie: Timeline = they want contract signed by Fri EOD. Blockers: 1) they require mutual TLS to our endpoint + cert chain details 2) VPC peering or private endpoint (no public egress) 3) SOC2 report + attestation copy 4) ask for 20% committed discount for 100M tokens/mo during POC
raj: For peering — we can do VPC peering or Private link. Need their CIDR, acceptance for routes, and port list (443 only). I can draft the peering checklist.
ana: (security) it's also data residency — they want EU-only processing and logs. Did sales confirm region selection? If they want EU, Hosted won't do unless we use private deployment.
sophie: We told them EU region is supported but they want written guarantee and logs stay in EU. Legal asked for network diagram and ingress/egress detail.
raj: Sample firewall rule we can provide:
```
# allow zenport app -> redwood private endpoint
allow tcp from 10.21.0.0/16 to 172.31.40.12 port 443
```
raj: For mTLS we need their CA chain + subjectAltName list; we can accept client certs on the private endpoint. I can produce config snippet for k8s ingress.
mike: Who can sign off on the 20% discount? Finance/RevOps path? We need to avoid giving full discount without exec ok.
oliver: CSM here — I'll set up a customer kickoff and ask them to attach the security questionnaire. Sophie, share the questionnaire link and I'll pull the answers.
ana: Also will need their vendor risk team contact for a quick call. Some items (data retention, log access) require legal review.
sophie: Added the ZenPort security questionnaire PDF to the deal record: https://redwood.internal/zenport/q1 (shared)
oliver: thanks — I'll start triaging answers.
mike: @jess fyi — Sophie asks for exec intro to help with discount + legal cadence. Can you jump on a call with their CTO?
jess: I can join a 30m call tomorrow 10am PT. Will need a one-pager we can send in advance outlining our EU controls and the Dedicated/Private options.
raj: I'll prepare the peering checklist + mTLS config by EOD and attach to the thread.
ana: I'll prepare an exportable SOC2 summary + isolation diagram, and note which logs may traverse control plane (need to call this out). ETA tomorrow AM.
sophie: Great — if we have written confirmation of EU-only processing + peering plan + SOC2, they will likely accept the contract. Also need pricing guidance — can we temporarily approve the 20% for the POC (3 months) pending RevOps sign-off?
mike: I'll escalate to RevOps. If they agree to a 3-month commit at 100M tokens/mo, 15% is baseline; 20% needs CRO sign-off. I'll ping Peter.
infra-bot: deploy-note: sharing internal peering template at /infra/peering-templates/zenport-v1 — use as reference :robot_face:
oliver: I'll coordinate a customer call for tomorrow 10:30 PT (post jess join). Sending invite after jess confirms.
sophie: Thanks all. Action items: raj -> peering+mTLS snippet (EOD), ana -> SOC2 + region note (tomorrow AM), mike -> RevOps pricing escalation, jess -> exec call. Will update thread with any new asks. :thumbsup:
mike: pinged Peter (revops) — he asked for ARR estimate and legal committed term. Sophie, pls add ARR estimate to deal record.
sophie: Added ARR = $420k ARR (estimated if conversion after POC). Also noted term request = 12 months post-POC.
jess: Confirmed I'll attend call at 10:30 PT. Hoping we can land a short exec intro and close out the legal Qs.
oliver: invite sent to ZenPort CTO + security lead + jess and our team. Thread will be used for pre-call prep.
sophie: If anyone has a one-pager on Private deployment quickstart, drop link here.
raj: private quickstart: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/private-quickstart.md — will highlight peering snippet in a PR.
sophie: Perfect — thanks everyone. Will follow up after call with final blockers.
